audit.why: Taliyah bullies the weak, immobile early ASol; he scales into a hypercarry (Stardust permanently improves his kit). Early Taliyah, late ASol.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flags it: chart gave Taliyah 7/7 while she wins only 46.86%. Content win[] had Taliyah on all seven rows; full layer had ASol on rows 5-6 with whys describing Taliyah winning.
audit.why: ASol's Stardust scaling and first-item spike are kit-certain; a 46.86% WR cannot come from a lane Taliyah wins at every stage. Full sides (Taliyah early, ASol from first item) are the plausible curve.
audit.corrected: Rows 3-4 unified on Taliyah (full flipped from Skill), rows 5-6 unified on Aurelion Sol (content flipped from Taliyah), all whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Never stated that Taliyah's CC interrupts both his Q channel and Astral Flight (both flagged interruptible); no cooldown digits (W 22s, E 12s, R 120s); Singularity execute and resistance-bypass (both flagged missing) absent.
audit.why: Kit: Q and W are channels any CC cancels; E is percent-health with a center execute; W 22/20.5/19/17.5/16.
audit.corrected: Folded into cooldowns, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, late.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke on every wave contact. Fresh-ground positioning is your real skill expression now.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — he is immobile and stack-hungry; Q-poke every farm attempt from your 1000 range.

edits.before: Weaver's Wall online — you are now the best roaming mid in the game. Every shove is a bot-lane gank announcement.
edits.after: Level 6 you stay ahead: his 120s Falling Star doesn't fix a starved lane, and your wall roams strike while he farms.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the W-E-Q rotation deletes squishies. Force river fights where your stones pre-seed the geometry.
edits.after: His first item turns stacked Breath of Light into a duel-winner — keep out-tempoing the map instead of trading with him.

edits.before: With items you out-tempo and roam while he grinds stacks.
edits.after: With items his stacks bite — out-tempo him, never duel.

edits.before: Late Taliyah edits maps: wall their reinforcements, shove their frontline into your team, and Q whatever stands on stones.
edits.after: Late his black hole executes and The Skies Descend wins fights — spend your wall to cut his angles, never take the 1v1.

edits.before: Late, E roots and wall zoning keep the starved ASol from landing his kit.
edits.after: Late his stacked kit and execute E outscale — zone with wall, don't duel.

edits.before: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Seismic Shove has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Astral Flight is 22s at rank 1 — his reposition and escape; he is a stationary battery while it is down, and your W or E interrupts the flight channel. - His E Singularity is 12s, R 120s. - Your W Seismic Shove (14s) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: Both his Q channel and his flight are interruptible — one W shove mid-breath ends the trade and strands him on a 22-second timer.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: His E pulls you toward a center that executes at low HP — W is the escape from the black hole; poked away, it can't save you.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP extends the post-6 roam pattern; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.

edits.before: If you kept him starved he never spikes; keep zoning with E and Q, and use Weaver's Wall to deny the fight angles his slow kit needs.
edits.after: If you kept him starved he never spikes; his E damage scales past MR stacking, so zone with E and wall rather than buying tank stats.

notes: Chart adjudication: packet flagged its own 7/7 Taliyah chart as contradicting the 46.86% WR. Kit evidence (permanent Stardust scaling, stacked-Q dueling, Singularity execute) supports the full layer's ASol rows 5-6, so I flipped content win[5]/win[6] to Aurelion Sol and full rows 3-4 from Skill to Taliyah — both layers now agree on Taliyah 0-4, ASol 5-6. Confidence Medium on the exact flip level (first item vs 2+ items); grounded on hyperscaler curve plus WR. Interrupt interactions (Q channel, Astral Flight) and both missingInteractions (execute, resistance bypass) folded in. All 4 lintFindings fixed.
